data.summary:
Errata rewriting the Monolith's [Eternity Gate](vsdata:ability/necrons.monolith.eternity-gate). In your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) from battle round two onward, you may pick 1 friendly **NECRONS INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield or in **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**:

- A unit picked on the battlefield is first moved into strategic reserves.
- The unit may then make an **[Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)**, arriving wholly within 6″ of the Monolith and **unengaged**, which replaces the usual need to be over 8″ horizontally away from every enemy unit.
- It may arrive even inside the deployment zone of your opponent.
- No **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** is allowed for that unit this turn.

typedMechanics.recipient: one friendly Necrons Infantry unit on battlefield or in Strategic Reserves
